definitions.gloss: boiling point (figurative); breaking point; peak of anger or excitement
definitions.explanation: boiling point (figurative); breaking point; peak of anger or excitement

examples.english: People with a low boiling point get angry quickly.

notes:
Literally the temperature at which a liquid begins to boil. Very commonly used figuratively to describe the point at which emotions — especially anger — reach a peak. The figurative expression {沸点|ふってん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ means someone is quick to anger.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {沸点|ふってん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: reach the boiling point
- {沸点|ふってん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: have a low boiling point (quick to anger)
- {沸点|ふってん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: have a high boiling point (patient, slow to anger)
